newsitem.title: USA: Quantum sets 2-for-1 common stock split.
newsitem.headline: Quantum sets 2-for-1 common stock split.

text.p: Quantum Corp on Tuesday said its board of directors has set a two-for-one common stock split, payable on or about June 9 to shareholders of record as of May 27.
The split will be in the form of a dividend, entitling holders to one share for every share held on the record date. On May 12, Quantum had over 65.7 million shares outstanding.

"We feel this is a good opportunity to increase the marketability of our shares and make it easier for individuals to invest in the company," Richard Clemmer, chief financial officer, said in a statement.
